meta.description: The rules for using The SaaS Harbor, how moderation works, and the limits of our responsibility.

about.title: About these terms
about.body: These terms apply when you use The SaaS Harbor, which is run by {operator}. You accept them when you create an account, by ticking the box on the sign-up form, and by using the site. If you do not agree, do not use the site. The <link>privacy policy</link> explains what we store about you and why.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Use your own name, or the name you are known by, and keep your email address up to date.
account.password: Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for everything that is done with your account.
account.delete: You can delete your account yourself at any time.

content.title: What you publish
content.ownership: Your products, profile and messages stay yours, and you are solely responsible for them. You must have the right to publish them, including logos and photos, and they must be accurate and lawful. By publishing a product or a profile, you let us show it on the site for as long as it is published.
content.checks: We do not check or verify what users publish, apart from reading the revenue figures described below. Only list products you run or are allowed to represent. An account can list up to {productLimit} products and add up to {dailyLimit} a day.

rules.title: What is not allowed
rules.illegal: Illegal content, such as fraud or material that infringes someone's rights.
rules.spam: Spam and unsolicited advertising, in listings as well as in messages.
rules.misleading: Misleading or false information about a product or a person.
rules.impersonation: Pretending to be someone else, or using their name, brand or work without permission.
rules.harassment: Harassment, threats or hateful content aimed at a person or a group.
rules.manipulation: Manipulating revenue verification or the leaderboard, for example with fake subscriptions or a payment provider account that belongs to another business.
rules.intrusion: Trying to reach other users' accounts or data, collecting it for spam, or disrupting the site.
rules.scraping: Copying or scraping the site's listings, profiles or figures in bulk, or republishing them elsewhere.

revenue.title: Revenue figures
revenue.source: Revenue figures are read from your payment provider through a read-only key you provide or read-only access you grant, and are calculated as described in <link>How it works</link>. We do not change them, but we do not guarantee that they are accurate, complete or up to date, and we may hide figures we have reason to believe were manipulated.
revenue.noAdvice: The figures and everything else on the site are information only. They are not financial, investment, legal or tax advice, and not an offer or recommendation to buy, sell or invest in anything. You are responsible for your own decisions and should check any information yourself before you rely on it.
revenue.keys: You are responsible for the keys you provide and the access you grant: that you are allowed to share them, and that they have only the read permissions described on the site. Your payment provider's own terms apply to your account there, and we are not responsible for the provider or its services.

messages.title: Messages and dealings between users
messages.private: Messages are private between two users. You can block a user, and limits stop an account from sending too many messages. Do not use messages for advertising people did not ask for.
messages.dealings: We are not a party to anything users discuss, agree or do between themselves, such as partnerships, sales, investments or other deals. Any such dealings, and any dispute that comes from them, are solely between the users involved and at their own risk. We do not verify users or what they say, and we do not mediate disputes.

moderation.title: Reports and moderation
moderation.reporting: Signed-in users can report a product, a profile or a message they received.
moderation.review: Admins appointed by the operator review every report themselves. Nothing is decided automatically. When something breaks these terms or the law, an admin can:
moderation.hide: Hide a product. It is no longer shown anywhere on the site.
moderation.suspend: Suspend an account. The profile and products are hidden, and the account cannot send messages or reports. The user can still sign in, edit their products and delete the account.
moderation.decision: The user concerned is told the decision, the reason and an explanation, but not who reported. Reporters are told the outcome of their reports. Admins may also act on problems they find without a report, and we may remove content or suspend accounts at our own discretion to protect the site, its users or us.
moderation.appeal: If you disagree with a decision, write to <contact></contact> and say why. We will look at the decision again and reply.

changes.title: Changes and availability
changes.body: We may change, suspend or stop the site or any part of it at any time, with or without notice. We may change these terms at any time. We then update the date at the top and tell registered users about significant changes. By continuing to use the site after a change, you accept the new terms.

warranties.title: No warranties
warranties.body: The SaaS Harbor is free to use and is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. We do not promise that the site is available, secure or free of errors, or that any information on it, including revenue figures, profiles and listings, is accurate, complete or up to date. You use the site and rely on its information at your own risk.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.intro: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {operator} and anyone working with us are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss or damage arising from your use of the site, including:
liability.profits: Lost profits, revenue, business, opportunities, goodwill or data.
liability.reliance: Losses from relying on information on the site, including revenue figures and what other users publish.
liability.conduct: Losses from the conduct of other users, including messages, misrepresentations and fraud, and from deals or disputes between users.
liability.errors: Losses from errors, interruptions, lost content, or unauthorised access to the site or your account.
liability.thirdParty: Losses connected with your payment provider or other third-party services.
liability.exceptions: These limits do not apply where the law does not allow them, for example for harm caused intentionally or by gross negligence.

indemnification.title: Indemnification
indemnification.body: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless {operator} and anyone working with us against any claims, losses, damages, costs and expenses, including reasonable legal fees, that arise from your use of the site, what you publish or send, your breach of these terms or the law, or any dispute between you and another user.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by Swedish law, and disputes are decided by the Swedish general courts, unless mandatory law gives you the right to go to court elsewhere.

language.title: Language
language.body: These terms are written in English. Translations are provided for convenience, and if a translation differs from the English version, the English version governs.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms, reports and appeals go to <contact></contact>.
